regions.today: Outbreaks of rain this afternoon, becoming more persistent and heavy through the evening. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in moderate south to southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Rain this evening will clear eastwards by early tonight. Long clear spells will develop. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 9 degrees in light southwest to west winds.
regions.tomorrow: A bright start to the week on Monday with sunshine. Showers will spread from the west.Highest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees in moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Low to moderate, high in any sunshine.
